name: Bratwurst
definition: raw seasoned minced pork (or pork and veal) German-style sausage in a casing, sold to be cooked.

name: Italian sausage
definition: raw pork sausage seasoned with fennel and garlic, sweet or hot, in links or loose, sold to be cooked.

name: Breakfast sausage
definition: raw small pork sausage links or patties seasoned with sage or maple, sold to be pan-fried.

name: Pepperoni
definition: dry-cured paprika-and-chilli pork and beef sausage, sold as a stick or sliced, for snacking or pizza.
